subject: Retroactive PO request and line-item mapping for AcmeCloud onboarding
messages:
From: Tim Grant <tim.grant@acmecloud.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: AcmeCloud Billing <billing@acmecloud.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: retro PO for onboarding charges and SKU mapping

Hi Jordan,

Quick one: our initial onboarding usage spiked last week while we were moving data into the Dedicated environment. Our finance team is asking for a PO number tied to that onboarding spend so they can reconcile the invoice. We don't have a PO on file for the usage between 2026-09-22 and 2026-09-28.

Summary of charges (vendor lines):
- onboarding-service (SKU: ONB-STD-1) — $7,200
- data-transfer (SKU: DT-GB-500) — $1,100
- setup-hours (SKU: SVC-SETUP) — $2,500

Attached: acme_onboarding_invoice_20261001.pdf (stub).

We also noticed two mis-labeled line items in the initial invoice that need to be reconciled to your PO mapping: one line showing DT-GB as a single aggregated line when our ledger expects DT-500/DT-0.

Can you issue a retroactive PO or provide guidance on how to map these lines, and confirm the spend cap we should be using going forward? We have an internal spend cap of $10k for this onboarding — we'd like to ensure we don't hit unexpected holds.

Thanks,
Tim Grant
Head of Cloud Procurement
AcmeCloud

Monica / Marissa — looping you in on Acme's retro PO request. Tim included a short invoice and flagged a DT line aggregation mismatch.

Questions:
1) Can Procurement issue a provisional/retroactive PO that covers 2026-09-22 to 2026-09-28 activity? If provisional, what naming/numbering convention would you use so billing can apply it retroactively?
2) Does Finance require a signed onboarding form before we assign a PO? Acme's CC'd billing address appears the same as their contract but I didn't see a signed onboarding form in the Drive link Tim sent.
3) On spend caps — Acme's internal cap is $10k. Should we mirror that on our side as a provisional spend cap while the PO is being finalized?

Action: Marissa, can you pull the onboarding form from the Drive link (below) and confirm whether we can proceed on a provisional PO? Ben — if we issue retro PO, please note any special ledger/line mapping constraints for downstream billing.

Related link: https://drive.redwood.ai/onboarding/acmecloud/2026-09-30

Thanks,
Jordan
Senior Sales Manager
Redwood Inference

What we can issue now:
- Provisional PO: PR-20261003-72 (will be converted to formal PO once onboarding form + SOW are received).
- Temporary spend cap: $10,000 (matches Acme internal), with note that any overages will require explicit approval and may be billed to the default billing profile.

Line-item mapping guidance:
- We'll create a three-line PO that maps to your invoice's SKUs. Please confirm the vendor SKUs below match internal ledger keys:
  1) ONB-STD-1 -> P-O-ONB-STD-2026
  2) DT-GB-500 -> P-O-DT-500-2026 (we will split if vendor provides the DT-0/DT-500 breakdown)
  3) SVC-SETUP -> P-O-SVC-SETUP-2026

Next steps (for Jordan / vendor):
- Tim or billing must upload a signed onboarding_form (attachment name: acme_onboarding_form_signed.pdf) to the Drive link or reply with DocuSign ID.
- If the vendor cannot provide the DT split, we'll create a provisional mapping and mark the DT line as "pending split" in the PO matrix.

I've attached a lightweight CSV mapping template: ponum_matrix_20261003.csv (stub). Fill vendor SKU column and return. Once we have that, I will issue PO_PR-72 and attach the PO PDF.
